The CA itself is a real, months-old ERC-20 with a $122.7k Sushiswap V3 pool, ~1,008 holders, approvals to known DEX routers — not a fresh scam deploy — so holders should not touch the claim-portal links, but this is NOT a launch to track. verdict: skip; do not whitelist the portal links.

Heat is real (velocity alert confirmed: +1028% in first 5 min, 567 transfers in ~17 min, sustained ~4h; 183 buys/53 sells, sells working) but the social identity is a name-squat: at least two prior Base tokens under the same 'Coinbase Champion'/INTERN/Base Intern names (0x184F442E65F343DEd2ED59AC8f988dc4c23B66C9 coinbase.com-indexed ~129d ago; 0x3519A636a01c39CD5D77b68C6c61D3aDb9189ba5 ~90d ago), plus a Solana $INTERN (FOMO AI Agents). Launched the same day as Coinbase's 'Coinbase Champions' live perps tournament in Singapore (Token2049, $150k prize, streamed on X) whose roster includes a trader literally named 'Intern' alongside Ansem, Jez, HDF. No website, no X account, no team, no KOL calls found. Event-hype piggyback, not an organic community. Verdict stays promising-onchain; Snug should weigh the name collision + unresolved LP lock (V4 pair, no plain LP token).

Real trading heat: trending on DEX screens (~5k txns in 18h, $1M+ volume, 883 makers), hoodwire movers +2,261%, listed on swap.ordofi.network's Robinhood token list; sells working (1618 buys/839 sells). But zero social infrastructure found — no website, no X account, no team, no KOL calls, no real-account ticker sharing. LP-lock unresolved (pair has code but totalSupply() reverts, 0 LP Transfer logs — not a plain V2 pair). Hype without substance; D = likely manufactured socials, onchain-only momentum.
